scope: Bounded non-repeated public-site diagnostic, not a reliability benchmark or proof of backend consent state
browser: Isolated Comet CDP on port 9333; separate owned tabs in one shared isolated profile. Consent state may persist across tabs.
privacy: Process-memory model credentials; no raw page content, query-token URLs, credentials or form values in this file. Sanitized per-run evidence is on the internal SSD under Library/Application Support/JevDiagnostics.
diagnostic_logging_caveat: One read-only retained-target diagnostic printed a Skyscanner session-handoff URL in transient tool output before subsequent origin/path-only sanitization. The token was not filed in this repository or the retained JSON evidence.
source_evolution: These runs span incremental guard and marker edits, not a frozen release; the offscreen fix followed the first two consent cases, and the Italian necessary-only label was allowed before the Skyscanner consent case. No paired causal comparison is claimed.
limits: Twelve approved paid ObjectiveAgent cases; one initial IKEA read-only preflight failed without model calls and was corrected before its paid case. No same-case automatic replay after uncertain input.

cases.input_uncertainty: original report lacks receipt phase; unchanged read-only target URL and zero history do not prove zero effects

Exact Italian essential-only label was permitted by the caller guard; no input passed validation. Which target choices Jev attempted was not retained; do not infer their cause.

cases.goal: open traveler/room controls without changing counts
cases.independent_dom_check: expanded trigger and visible linked panel with controls

read_only_gaps: Guardian: consent controls live in a cross-origin iframe; observed top-level modal offers no actionable rejection. No paid run or input.
BBC: small non-modal banner had an Accept control but no explicit reject in the observed action table. No consent input.
eBay UK: control facts exceeded the 250-item cap, so prepared fill remains intentionally unauthorized. No paid run or input.
Reuters: no actionable elements on the sampled read-only page; do not infer agent capability.
mitigations: Offscreen reveal-action truncation no longer nulls fill identity when all control facts and the visible action table are complete; omitted offscreen peers still enter the identity marker. Capped control facts or visible actions still fail closed.

Reusable caller-owned safety veto allows explicit optional-cookie rejection or necessary-only choices and rejects optional acceptance/account/booking/purchase labels; Jev still chooses the operation and observed node.
Consent runner requires one acknowledged browser input, a fresh absent dialog, stable URL/title, and refuses redirect URLs with query/fragment tokens before invoking the planner.
Live regression runner now retains code-owned receipt phase, input_started and error types without raw input text; historical HN receipt detail cannot be recovered.
verification: 707 offline pytest cases after added offscreen-peer and action-overflow regressions; Ruff with AppleDouble sidecars excluded; Node syntax checks on snapshot.js and app.js; uv build using an internal-SSD virtualenv; git diff --check. Offline tests used no paid API.
